newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Jan tax collection to reach $4.4 bln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Jan tax collection to reach $4.4 bln.

text.p: Argentine tax collection in January will be around $4.4 billion, up from $4.1 billion in January 1996, said Guillermo Rodriguez Use, undersecretary for tax policy, according to local media Friday.

According to financial daily Ambito Financiero, Use said tax collection of $4.4 billion would represent the highest amount collected in the month of January since Argentine introduced Convertibility pegging the value of the peso to the dollar at par in 1991.

Analysts said that considering tax collected had reached $4.1 billion by Jan 29, it was perfectly possible the figure would reach $4.4 billion because of the revenues collected from value added, income and petrol taxes in the last days of the month.
